interaction_rules: ActionPanel activates only when it is the player's turn; disabled/greyed out otherwise
Unavailable actions auto-hide (e.g. Call hidden when no bet to call, show Check instead)
Raise click expands amount selector with slider + quick-bet buttons (1/3, 1/2, 2/3, pot, all-in)
All-in requires secondary confirmation dialog to prevent misclick
Single-click submits action immediately (no double confirm) for gameplay rhythm
Raise amount input validates on blur; illegal values auto-correct to nearest legal value
Stack depth input: range 20-500BB with preset buttons, real-time validation with inline error
All filters apply instantly without submit button (real-time list refresh)
BOT thinking: 500-1500ms simulated delay with animated dots on active BOT seat
Deal animation: cards fly from deck to seats (~300ms/card) with flip reveal
Chips animate from player to pot on bet (~200ms), pot to winner on showdown
Community cards flip sequentially (Flop 3 cards in sequence, Turn/River single flip)
Page transitions use fade+slide (~200ms duration)
Winner highlight: pot chips slide to winner + seat pulse glow animation
Replay keyboard shortcuts: ← previous / → next / Space play-pause
Auto-replay mode: 2s per decision point, adjustable speed (1x/2x/3x)
Decision timeline: horizontal clickable bar, red markers on severe deviations
Deviation color coding: green = GTO match, yellow = minor deviation, red = severe deviation
Each hand auto-saves to IndexedDB on completion; no manual save needed
Session state auto-persists on pause and browser close; recoverable on reopen
Empty history state: illustration + prompt text + CTA to start first game
Insufficient stats data: prompt 'complete at least 10 hands for meaningful stats'
Filter no results: prompt to adjust filter criteria
IndexedDB unavailable: toast warning, allow usage but disable save features
Export failure: toast error with retry button
Engine error: error modal with 'restart this hand' option
